text:
Mia Chen: Hey team — Corvus Health renewal is on a hard date 06/30. Procurement is asking for our vendor code and an invoice addressed to their EU entity. They say legal requires a PO before e-sign. We're blocked on signatures. Any updates?

Samir Patel: Pinged their procurement contact (procurement@corvushealth.com). They replied they'll only issue a PO once internal GL/vendor mapping is done — asking for our vendor code and bank docs.

Procurement-Bot: Reminder: Please complete vendor registration: https://forms.redwood.com/vendor-request/CH-234 :eyes:

Olivia Gomez: Legal note — we can accept either (a) PO + eSign or (b) PO + signed SOW. Need confirmation of the invoice entity (EU vs UK) and VAT ID to ensure correct billing entity.

Mia Chen: It's EU (Ireland). Corvus CFO indicated invoices should be to "Corvus Health EU Ltd" and supplied a VAT ID in email. Copying Samir for follow-up.

Samir Patel: They said they can't issue the PO until bank details line up with the invoice entity. Can Legal confirm what supporting docs Redwood can provide to satisfy them?

Olivia Gomez: Yes — we can provide a one-page billing addendum and bank proof. I'll draft the addendum and upload the vendor data bundle here in a few minutes.

Harry Lowe: FYI — renewal TCV is ~$120k. Customer is requesting 12 months vs our proposed 9 months. Sales prefers 12 to close. Any billing/contract risk if we push to 12?

Mia Chen: Onboarding health: enablement at ~75% (training + SSO done, usage ramping). Low product risk if we keep them live, but Finance requires PO before activating Dedicated capacity. So procurement delay = activation delay.

Tara Nguyen: Captured pilot feedback: they flagged latency on long transcript jobs — opened ticket INF-321 and assigned to eng-runtime. Putting this on the renewal notes.

Samir Patel: Corvus replied: "We can provide a scanned PO but need Redwood's vendor code + bank proof. Signatory is OOO until Friday — earliest e-sign Monday. Will eSign then if docs are ok."

Olivia Gomez: Drafted billing addendum and vendor bundle. Snippet below: 
```
Billing Addendum v1:
- Entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (EU)
- VAT: GB123456789
- Bank: HSBC UK, Sort code 12-34-56
- Invoice term: Net30
```
I'll attach the full PDF once finalized.

Mia Chen: Thanks. Samir — can you ask them to send the PO scan (PDF) addressed to "Redwood Inference Ltd (EU)" and it's fine to leave vendor code blank if they don't have ours yet.

Samir Patel: Sent that ask. Corvus: "We can scan + provide PO number; vendor code left blank. Also asking if Redwood can split invoice monthly instead of up-front." New ask from procurement.

Harry Lowe: Sales note — monthly invoicing reduces cash certainty. We can offer monthly invoicing for a 12-month commitment >= $120k with a 2% admin fee. Approvals needed from Finance.

Mia Chen: CS is OK with monthly invoicing if it helps close. Finance — can you advise on the 2% fee & amendment wording?

Procurement-Bot: Customer invoice preference recorded: https://billing.redwood.com/po/CH-234 (reference CH-234)

Olivia Gomez: I can accept monthly invoices but will include it in the amendment along with the 2% admin fee and payment schedule. Drafting amendment now.

Tara Nguyen: Logged process improvement — add "vendor code form" and "bank proof" to renewal checklist so next cycle we don't stall on procurement.

Samir Patel: Corvus update: "Signatory back Monday, will eSign then. PO scan en route today to your mailbox." I'll drop it here when it arrives.

Mia Chen: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging legal + finance for final review when the addendum and PO land. :thumbsup: :raised_hands:
